link_rules.function_alignment: none: SDK functions follow each other as in the archive member; do not ALIGN(8) between them
link_rules.padding: keep each object's trailing padding (layout.pad_bytes) as data words or asm; members pad to 16 or more, and some start at 4 mod 8
link_rules.relocations: matches are relocation-masked; data and symbol references are the game build's own byte gate
